coverage_explanation: Tests serial-to-LCD text forwarding and serial echo for newline-delimited and idle-delimited input, including spaces, punctuation, mixed case, and repeated input. The available LCD checks observe text API output only; they cannot verify black clearing, white text, text size, cursor position, or landscape rotation.
assumptions: Use the explicitly supplied wiring: D/C=9, CS=10, MOSI=11, MISO=12, SCK=13; no bench-default wiring is needed.
Serial baud is 9600 and messages are framed by newline or 20 ms of inactivity, as specified in the case data.
Newline is treated as a framing delimiter; checks do not require the delimiter itself to appear in output.
No exact response deadline is specified; observation windows allow serial transmission, idle framing, and display updates.
LCD checks validate API text output, not physical pixels or graphical styling.
